exposure: Approach to internal iliac artery ligation (round ligament division vs. pouch of Douglas approach)
outcome: Effectiveness of internal iliac artery ligation in controlling pelvic hemorrhage
Clinical situations where each approach is most appropriate
cohort: Women undergoing internal iliac artery ligation for pelvic hemorrhage
finding: Both the round ligament and pouch of Douglas approaches for internal iliac artery ligation are equally effective in controlling pelvic hemorrhage, with the choice of approach depending on the specific clinical situation.
